A '''Witch's Sack''' is an {{Epic}} [[Sack]] bought from {{NPCSprite|Agnes}}. It can hold {{Green|20,160}} of ingredients from the [[Year of the Witch]].

== Obtaining ==
A '''Witch's Sack''' can be bought from {{NPCSprite|Agnes}} for {{Item|Festering Fly|amount=16}} and {{Item|Spider Egg|amount=16}}.

== Usage ==
The '''Witch's Sack''' can store items obtained from the [[Year of the Witch]].
